title: Museum Date
description: Wander around a museum together and each choose your favourite thing you see.

title: Farmers Market
description: Wander around a farmers market together and pick out something tasty to share.

title: Mini Golf
description: Play a round of mini golf and add a silly little prize for the winner.

title: Bowling
description: Go bowling together and make up a playful challenge for each round.

title: Pottery Class
description: Take a pottery class together and make something you can keep from the date.

title: Paint Together
description: Get some simple art supplies and paint side by side, or paint something for each other.

title: Beach Walk
description: Take a long walk by the water and stop somewhere nice to sit and talk.

title: Go for a Hike
description: Choose a trail, pack some snacks, and spend a few hours exploring together.

title: Mini Road Trip
description: Pick somewhere nearby you have never explored and turn the drive into part of the date.

title: Breakfast Date
description: Go out for breakfast or make a slow breakfast together at home.

title: Dessert Date
description: Skip straight to dessert and find somewhere delicious to share something sweet.

title: Try a New Restaurant
description: Choose a restaurant neither of you has tried before and order something new.

title: Arcade Date
description: Hit an arcade, play a few games, and see who can win the best prize.

title: Thrift Store Challenge
description: Give each other a tiny budget and find the funniest or best thing you can for one another.

title: Photo Walk
description: Explore somewhere on foot and take photos of little things that catch your attention.

title: At-Home Spa Night
description: Put on relaxing music, make the room cosy, and give yourselves a slow spa night at home.

title: Build a Blanket Fort
description: Build an unnecessarily elaborate blanket fort and spend the evening inside it together.

title: Watch the Sunrise
description: Wake up early, bring something warm to drink, and watch the day begin together.

title: Take a Dance Class
description: Try a dance class together, even if neither of you knows what you are doing.

title: Bike Ride
description: Pick a scenic route, take your bikes out, and stop somewhere nice along the way.
